description.en: Sets a temporary, non-persistent bit flag (not written to the save file), identified by a numeric bit index. Used for short-lived state such as "has this healing/coin event already been handled this session".
Index of the temporary bit flag to set.
Optional value to set (defaults to true when omitted).
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).
